meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

copy.tagline: 为聊天助手装上跨会话记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给 Grok 机器人增加持久记忆能力。
copy.tagline_en: Give your chat assistant persistent memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add lasting memory to your Grok bot.

howto.what: 在 Grok Bot 上装好 claude-mem 后,本机会起一个 worker,按每个 agent 监视会话记录,并由 CMEM Pro 观察者生成记忆;真实任务开始时通过 MCP 提供 session_start_context 上下文。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上安装或配置 claude-mem 时使用;默认走本地 worker + CMEM Pro 观察者,不需要 Cursor。

say.text: 在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem
say.note: 默认装本地 worker 和 CMEM Pro 观察者

say.text: 用 --provider host 装本机登录观察者
say.note: 改走本机登录的 loopback shim

howto.what_en: On Grok Bot, installing claude-mem starts a local worker on 127.0.0.1, watches transcripts per agent, and runs a CMEM Pro observer; at the start of a real task MCP supplies session_start_context.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot; the default path is a local worker plus a CMEM Pro observer, and Cursor is not required.

say_en.note: Defaults to local worker + CMEM Pro observer

say_en.text: Install with --provider host for the local login observer
Install in remote mode pointing at https://cmem.ai
